subject: Security questionnaire onboarding / clarifying evidence routing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Fernandez <alex.fernandez@miralabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security questionnaire onboarding / clarifying evidence routing

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can route the questionnaire work: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: Mira Labs wants to integrate Redwood for document summarization + PII redaction on user-uploaded assets.
- Expected traffic: proof-of-concept then ramp to ~5k requests/day.
- Compliance flag: customers in EU + occasional PHI scenarios flagged by enterprise customers.

Clarifying questions we noted on the call (please confirm):
1) SOC 2: you mentioned an audit is in flight — can you confirm target report type (Type I vs Type II) and expected completion month?
2) Data residency: are any production datasets required to remain in EU only, or will US/EU mixed hosting be acceptable?
3) Downstream vendors: do you route any customer data to third-party processors (analytics/CDN/AI preprocessors) we should map on the SIG?
4) Evidence owners: who on your side should receive the SIG prefill and the network diagram request? a security@ or a named person?

Recommended next steps from our side
- We can send a SIG (standard) prefill template or a CAIQ — because you flagged PHI, we generally recommend the full SIG for thorough mapping.
- If you prefer, we can prefill the SIG where we have answers (hosting, encryption at rest, key management) and leave items for your security team to confirm.
- Please share a preferred evidence timeline (e.g., 10 business days) and an owner for each ask.

Attachments: call-recording-link.mp3 (recording), meeting-notes.pdf (short notes)

If it's easier, loop in your security point (I saw security@ on the company site) and I'll drop the prefill plus a short checklist. Happy to schedule a 30-min intake tomorrow or Friday.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for product teams
From: Alex Fernandez <alex.fernandez@miralabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@miralabs.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire onboarding / clarifying evidence routing

Hi Soojin — great summary, thanks. Answers below and a few quick asks from our side.

Answers/clarifications:
- SOC 2: we are currently mid-audit aiming for SOC 2 Type II (controls in place Jan–Jun 2026; report delivery expected end of Oct 2026). We have a SOC contact at security@miralabs.com who can share the pre-report artifacts.
- Data residency: most customers are global; we have EU-only deployments for a handful of enterprise customers (we can mark those in the SIG). For the POC we can use US hosting, but please list EU residency as an option.
- Downstream vendors: we use CloudStreams (metrics) and DocStore (S3-compatible) — both are contractually bound as sub-processors; I can provide their dataflow docs.
- Evidence owners: please send the prefill to security@miralabs.com and CC me. Security lead is Priya Kaur (Priya.Kaur@miralabs.com).

Our asks:
- What's the minimum evidence set you need to move forward (we can prioritize)?
- Can Redwood prefill answers for standard infra controls (encryption, patching, IAM) so we only confirm?

Happy to get the SIG prefill and a kickoff invite. Thanks for being flexible on the form selection — if SIG is the recommended path given PHI, let's proceed.

Warmly,
Alex Fernandez
Director of Platform, Mira Labs
alex.fernandez@miralabs.com

Logistics and links

Next steps (short)
